introduction_markdown: This paper is arranged in two sections, A and B. Answer ALL questions in Sections A and B. Section A: answer ALL the questions (15 questions); the mark allocation for each question is indicated. Section B: answer ALL four questions; all questions in Section B carry equal marks (15 marks each). You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed. Duration: two and a half hours.
enonce_intro_markdown:
Miriam sold Rice, Beans, Corn and Garri in buckets on a particular day. She made a profit per bucket for each item sold as follows:

Rice: 600 FCFA, Beans: 500 FCFA, Corn: 300 FCFA and the profit for Garri was $\dfrac23$ of the profit for Rice.

Find:
incertitudes: Q B1 (d) : le sujet imprime « She used 2/5 of her profit for to buy fish » (faute dans l'original) ; recopié en « to buy fish ». Les phrases intercalées (« She used ... ») ont été rattachées à la sous-question qu'elles précèdent.

questions.enonce_markdown: The profit per bucket of Garri on that day.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Garri: $\dfrac23\times 600 = 400$ FCFA.

**Profit per bucket of Garri = 400 FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown: The ratio of the profit per bucket of Rice and Garri sold.
The total profit she made on that day from selling 4 buckets of Rice, 2 buckets of Beans, 5 buckets of Corn and 4 buckets of Garri.
questions.corrige_markdown:
| Item | Buckets | Profit per bucket (FCFA) | Profit (FCFA) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rice | 4 | 600 | 2400 |
| Beans | 2 | 500 | 1000 |
| Corn | 5 | 300 | 1500 |
| Garri | 4 | 400 | 1600 |

Total profit $= 2400 + 1000 + 1500 + 1600 = 6500$ FCFA.

**Total profit = 6,500 FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown: She used $\dfrac25$ of her profit to buy fish. Calculate the amount spent to buy fish.
She used $\dfrac1{13}$ of the remainder of her profit for her taxi fare and saved the rest. Find her taxi fare.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Remainder after buying fish: $6500 - 2600 = 3900$ FCFA.

Taxi fare: $\dfrac1{13}\times 3900 = 300$ FCFA.

**Taxi fare = 300 FCFA.**
